Upon hearing the counsel for parties and perusal of the impugned
20→order, we do find from the impugned order that there are several

petitioner is required to be relegated to an alternative remedy

whereunder, the petitioner can file an application before the

date. If such an application is filed, the same is directed to be

from the date of filing of the said application and after a proper
